half_of: full R1 = 16631 frames, ts 200000 .. 166500000 (4053 dump-only frames + data/7piezo_traj2_dedup.csv); first floor(16631/2)

from_dumps.conversion: type-2 atom per protein sorted by atom id (= mol 999999..999993), np.mod(raw_A, 3440.3686) / delta_std on every axis, repr floats

seams: production 1/2 share ts 5250000-5300000 (6 frames: identical at 5250000, then diverge up to 30.9 A) and 2/3 share 25250000 (identical); the later production is kept, as traj2_dedup does

validation.note: no wrap disagreements (raw and min-imaged diff equal); 2e-3 = dump 6-significant-digit print precision

xy_step_max.note: the large steps are the first frames after the lattice start (200000->210000: 2.3-8.6)

guard_csv.what: raw box-centred dump coords for the dump rows, data/7piezo_traj2_unwrapped_angstrom.csv rows (last copy per ts) after; read only by the arms alignment guard

scratch: $S = a scratch working directory for intermediate files, not kept; merge_dumps.py and make_csvs.py (scripts/membrane/data_prep/half/) ran with it as the working directory
